UPSSSC Excise Constable Exam City Details 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the exam city details for the Post of Excise Constable posts. This recruitment was released for 820 posts. Applications for the UPSSSC Excise Constable Various Post Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 04 June 2026 to 24 June 2026. The examination is going to conducted on 20 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPSSSC Excise Constable Exam City Details 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 04 June 2026
  • Last Date : 24 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 June 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 01 July 2026
  • Eligibility Result : 28 July 2026
  • Mains Exam Fees Payment : 25 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 20 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 11 September 2026
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
